{{Quote|They're your basic schlubs, big wedge&ndash;shaped heads and giant eyes. Can't miss 'em.|Gault Rennow|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Arcona''', sometimes singular '''Arconan''', were scaleless reptiles with [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] bodies. Hailing from the tropical desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cona/Legends|Cona]] in the [[Teke Ro system]], they had poor eyesight, despite their large eyes, and had a small organ between their eyes which, often mistaken for their nose, helped them to see. An Arcona's lifespan was roughly the same as a [[Human/Legends|Human's]]. The Arcona lived in a family-based community, where the males took care of the young, as the females were generally reckless and thrill-seeking. Despite not being a particularly technological species, by the time the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] rose to power, Arcona could be seen in every corner of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were also notorious for their easy addiction to common [[Salt/Legends|salt]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Arcona.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Hem Dazon/Legends|Hem Dazon]], in the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Cantina]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]]]
The Arcona had flat, anvil-shaped heads, sharp claws, clear, marble-like eyes, and thick, protective skin that ranged in tone from olive to ebony. [[Cona/Legends|Cona]], the native [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the Arcona, was always hot, and had very little [[Water/Legends|water]]. The [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was filled with [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]] vapor. The Arcona adapted to this environment by eating the ammonia-converting roots of the complex flora of Cona as a source of water (the only water planet-wide). The Arcona depended on the ammonia to live and, as a result, Arcona living offworld had to take ammonia supplements or risk death.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

Despite their bulbous eyes, the Arcona had very poor eyesight. Their eyes could not detect fine shapes as they were made up of thousands of tiny [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] like those of an insect, so they only saw blurry objects. To aid their poor eyesight, the Arcona had a small diamond-shaped sensory organ between their eyes. Often mistaken for their nose, this organ detected heat patterns from living beings. Thus, the Arcona could recognize someone or something by its heat pattern. Like many reptiles, the Arcona had olfactory organs located in their ever-moving tongues. This helped them distinguish objects in their environment that they otherwise could not make out and also gave them a keen sense of smell.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

==Society and culture==
[[File:ArconaUUA.jpg|thumb|right|150px|An Arcona]]
Arcona normally thought of themselves not as individuals but as a collective whole. Largely forsaking individuality, they often referred to themselves as "we" even when alone. The Arcona lived in loose, family-based communities called nests, which were ruled by a [[Grand Nest]]. Because Arcona were born in nests underground, they obtained a close sense of family living in close quarters with brothers and sisters.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

The [[Language/Legends|language]] of the Arcona was [[Arconese/Legends|Arconese]], which came from their home planet of Cona. However, on off-world colonies, Arcona young were rarely taught Arconese, as they could learn [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] easily.<ref name="UAA" />

Arcona females were considered far more reckless and free-spirited than their male counterparts, so the males usually raised the children. Arcona took much time courting a partner, and the commitment to marry was also a commitment to parent.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

Arcona were highly susceptible to addiction to [[Salt/Legends|salt]], which served as a hallucinogen.<ref name="UAA" /> Their eyes shifted from green to gold after prolonged addiction.<ref name="TEGtAS" /><ref name="TNEGtAS" /> The effects of salt on the Arcona resembled that of intoxication; an Arcona was seen in a dive bar consuming a soup in which he had poured an entire salt shaker's worth of salt, then was observed stumbling out of a cantina "like it was last call."<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
[[File:Salt_Deal_FH.png|thumb|left|200px|An Arcona salt addict]]
Before they made contact with the greater galaxy, the Arcona were not technologically advanced. Although they eventually used sentient technology, they never developed any of their own. When scouts from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] first arrived on Cona, many Arcona were extremely enthusiastic about exploring the galaxy; oftentimes, whole communities sought to travel off-world. As a consequence, Arcona colonies were quite common throughout the galaxy. After adapting to other species' technology not present on Cona, the Arcona were commonly seen in every spaceport in the galaxy.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

Offworlders initially traded water for mineral rights, but soon discovered that salt was a highly addictive hallucinogen for the Arcona. Traders then imported large amounts of salt before communities outlawed the dealings. In the long run, it was only the Republic that saved the Arcona from pandemic addiction, passing laws which punished salt sales on Cona.<ref name="UAA" /> Salt-addicted Arcona could be easily recognized because their eyes turned from green to gold.<ref name="DecipherDazon">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Hem Dazon}}</ref> Because of the large number of addicts, many people believed that the natural Arcona eye color was gold.<ref name="TEGtAS" />

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power, the Arcona largely made up the institution's most vocal supporters when they learned of its desire to form a united galaxy. Because this fit with their notion of a uniform galaxy,<ref name="AA">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref> the Arcona quickly pledged support but had joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sometime during the [[Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> When the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] the galaxy, the Arcona homeworld was [[Attack on Cona|attacked]] and invaded by the alien horde and only freed after the war's end by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

==Arcona in the galaxy==
[[File:Arcona_Rumor_Monger-BotF.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An Arcona rumor monger]]
Due to their communal nature, the majority of Arcona who traveled offworld sought scientific development to bring back to their nests on Cona. Having spread out across the galaxy to follow the urge of exploration, entire families could be found living near every major [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] working as employees of major shipping or mining conglomerates, as well as simple tourists.<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> At the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Arcona Compound|camp]] for salt-addicted Arcona was established on the jungle world [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>

[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] was not uncommon among the Arcona, and many found themselves involved in the Force traditions of the greater galaxy. While no Arcona were ever recorded as joining the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], many Force-sensitive Arcona were initiated in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] until the time of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] and the collapse of the Republic.<ref name="UAA" /> Two Arcona [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] served the [[New Jedi Order|Order]] after it was rebuilt during the time of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]; [[Vaala Razelle]] and [[Izal Waz]].<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>
